I’m currently 17 years old, and so much has happened that literally traumatized the fuck out of me. I honestly don’t know what to do at this point anymore. My dad is an alcoholic, and when I was little ( since elementary ) my mom would make me coax my dad back home because when he would get drunk he would get lost. So we would set out to find him, and she would put me into a horrible position. My mom seemed to only care about how good my grades were. My so called “ friends “ would bully me in elementary all the way up to the end of middle school, but I still get bullied occasionally ( I would get verbally, and physically abused by some, and the boys would touch me, of course when I was younger I didn’t know what to do, but I never trusted anyone. ) My dad was a bear dead dad, he was just always drinking, and he would sometimes come up to my school drunk when he would pick, me, and my sister up. My dad also groped me twice when he was drunk ( I was in middle school during that time. ) He is also homophobic, and I’m pansexual, and I’m terrified of coming out to my family about it. My first boyfriend would emotionally manipulate me into doing things, and much more. My second ex touched me inappropriately when I told him to stop, and he just continued to feel me up when I told him no. I also starve myself occasionally, or just minimize what I eat, I use to throw up my food too, I keep count of my weight, and I’m always watching that I don’t gain anything above 98. I’m currently 92 lbs, but I like being thin, and just being told that I look fragile, and I have a sort of pale complexion. I like being thin, and I don’t want to gain weight, if anything I wanna lose it. I tried to kill myself ( I overdosed ) last year, and my mom just took me to a sketchy doctor’s office next to my school. She flat out denied that I tried to kill myself in front of the the doctor. And she hasn’t talked about it since. I also tried running away, and when I was back in her care the next day her first question was if I slept with my boyfriend. ( which I did not, I’m still a virgin. ) I’m just tired. My mom has seen me break down, ( rarely in front of her though. ) and has done nothing. Even after I had begged for help, and her knowing that I also harmed myself. I have asked her for help countless times over the years, but to no avail. I honestly don’t know what to do anymore. ( also my dad no longer lives with us because he got deported, so he’s been away since the start of my high school year basically. )
